# implicit-sdf.library: DistanceToLine

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The signed distance from a point to the line with the given unit normal at
> signed offset from the origin — the planar counterpart of DistanceToPlane,
> and the boundary of a half-plane. Exact. Precondition: normal has unit
> length.

## Signature

```plato
DistanceToLine(p: Point2D, normal: Vector2D, offset: Number): Number
```

These are declared laws. Whether each one passes is recorded by the law runner ([stdlib/VERIFICATION.md](../../../../../stdlib/VERIFICATION.md)), not by this page.

### Law_LineIsPlaneSlice

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 130](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L130)

```plato
// A line is the z = 0 slice of the plane with the same in-plane normal.
Law_LineIsPlaneSlice(p: Point2D, normal: Vector2D, offset: Number): Boolean
    => DistanceToLine(p, normal, offset)
        .LawEq(DistanceToPlane(
            Point3D(p.X, p.Y, 0.0),
            Vector3D(normal.X, normal.Y, 0.0),
            offset));
```
